program.section_heading: Energy Corps (Non Credit) — CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION
outcomes: Demonstrate correct wiring and installation techniques
Follow proper procedures and observe OSHA safety protocols
Demonstrate knowledge of OSHA safety standards
Demonstrate the correct and safe use of various diagnostic tools and equipment
Identify the evaluation procedure, steps and protocols required for accurate energy data collection
Accurately answer questions on retrofit procedure, steps, analysis, components, and safety protocols required in the lighting retrofit trade;
Accurately demonstrate correct and safe use of various lighting diagnostic tools/equipment
Discuss the interrelationship of craft skills, construction industry, and green workers to the construction process for alternative energy
Describe the basic elements of green construction and green energy buildings

notes: The award is counted in hours: each course prints its hours in the title and 0.0 in the Units column; hours were recorded in the units fields.
The 136-hour total is printed as 'Total Hours of Completion (136 Hours)' directly under the required courses, so it was also recorded as that block's stated total.
The text says students must complete the four (4) required courses. AED 90.01 must be completed before enrolling in AED 90.02.
AED 90.08 (80 hours) and AED 90.09 (90 hours) are printed under 'Optional Elective' and are not part of the 136-hour requirement, so they were not placed in a block.

The outcomes list contains the line 'Standard grading will be used'. It is not an outcome, so it was left out. It may continue the preceding outcome, which ends in a semicolon; a reviewer should check this.
The outcome ending 'lighting retrofit trade;' is copied with its trailing semicolon as printed.
